choose.when: ORDER BY r.occurred_at ASC, r.id DESC
choose.otherwise: ORDER BY r.occurred_at DESC, r.id DESC

choose.when: ORDER BY r.created_at ASC, r.id DESC
choose.otherwise: ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC

mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.type, r.status, r.title, r.description, r.category_id, c.name AS category_name, r.location, r.occurred_at, r.contact, r.publisher_name, r.deleted_at, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM t_record r LEFT JOIN t_category c ON c.id = r.category_id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_record (type, status, title, description, category_id, location, occurred_at, contact, publisher_name) VALUES (#{type}, #{status}, #{title}, #{description}, #{categoryId}, #{location}, #{occurredAt}, #{contact}, #{publisherName})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_record SET type = #{type}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, category_id = #{categoryId}, location = #{location}, occurred_at = #{occurredAt}, contact = #{contact}, publisher_name = #{publisherName} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.type, r.status, r.title, r.category_id, c.name AS category_name, r.location, r.occurred_at, r.created_at FROM t_record r LEFT JOIN t_category c ON c.id = r.category_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.status = 'PENDING' AND r.id IN #{id}
